instruction: Check the book reading record on the desktop to find which book took the longest time to finish. Write its title in book_list_result.docx.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully examined the book reading spreadsheet, visited howlongtoread.com to look up word counts for each book, calculated words per day, identified 'Out of the Silent Planet' as having the slowest reading pace, and wrote the title to book_list_result.docx.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open and read spreadsheets in LibreOffice Calc, navigate to external websites in Chrome, look up book information, perform calculations (words/day), open and type in LibreOffice Writer documents, save files.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the agent's ability to calculate reading duration from start/end dates in the spreadsheet. The Lost Symbol has the longest reading period (66 days, from 4/5/22 to 6/10/22). This variation requires date arithmetic rather than word count lookups, testing a different analytical skill with the same data.
metadata.explanation: Custom getter reads the docx file from VM and extracts text. Metric checks if the text contains 'The Lost Symbol' (the book that took the longest to read at 66 days). Partial credit given for partial title matches.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads docx file from VM and extracts paragraph text, targeting the correct file path (book_list_result.docx).
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' type expected parameter — accesses expected.get('expected_title') directly from the rules dict, which is the correct pattern.
Case-insensitive containment check is appropriate for verifying a book title was written to the document.
Postconfig correctly activates the Writer window and saves with Ctrl+S before the getter reads the file, ensuring persisted state.
Partial credit logic (word overlap at 0.5 weight) is reasonable for partial title matches.

Expected value 'The Lost Symbol' with 66-day reading period (4/5/22 to 6/10/22) is stated in task rationale but cannot be independently verified against the actual spreadsheet data — minor uncertainty.
Coverage is complete: instruction requires finding longest-time book and writing to docx; evaluator verifies the correct title appears in the docx.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying the expected value 'The Lost Symbol' against the actual spreadsheet data to confirm it truly has the longest reading duration (66 days).
